title: Monthly Raku Fire Party
source_quote: A monthly Raku Fire party provides a wonderful pottery experience where you come in and glaze pots and fire them in the Raku kilns
evidence_sentence: Sullivan Pottery's homepage describes monthly raku fire parties where potters can glaze and fire their work.
